extracted.name: Scandi-style oysters
extracted.description: Serve up a fresh batch of oysters topped with capers, dill and zingy lemon juice for a light dish everyone will enjoy. Try it as a special seafood starter
instruction_lines: Mix together the dill and capers, then use it to top the freshly shucked oysters and serve straight away.
